expected_claims.name: anymd (formerly PDF Reader MCP)
expected_claims.tagline: General local MCP and command-line document-to-Markdown extraction.
expected_claims.description: The Sylphx maintainer has renamed pdf-reader-mcp to anymd. The project documents a local MCP server and command-line tool for converting PDFs and other document formats into Markdown, with search and optional OCR capabilities. It is general document extraction software, not a legal-analysis or citation-verification system. Review local file access, optional model downloads and the current migration/setup instructions before use. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
expected_claims.pricing_details: MIT-licensed local server/CLI. Maintainer also offers a separately hosted, metered parsing service; confirm any hosted or optional-model costs.
